shared_elements: carved stone pillar/upright monolith as the decorated field
animal figures in profile carved in relief
stacked or tiered composition of figures on a vertical surface
justification: Both surfaces present a vertical stone upright bearing carved figural imagery, with animal/creature forms rendered in low relief in a stacked, tiered arrangement, and both include a beaked or bird-headed creature. However, A is a flat panel densely covered with registers of distinct profile animals (quadrupeds, birds, snake-like and small human-like figures) plus a band of geometric pattern, whereas B is a single three-dimensional standing figure with a large head and arms/hands brought to the body, so the relationships and overall composition differ substantially.
